## Key Insights

1. Summer Sowing Status: As on March 21, 2025, the area sown under the summer crops is 48.12 lakh ha as compared to 43.07 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. Of this, area of 28.49 lakh ha has been sown under rice this year against the previous year area of 25.85 lakh ha (increase of 2.64 lakh ha).
2. Rabi harvesting Status: As on 20.03.2025, 35.32 % of area has been harvested all over India. Approximately 57.00% area of Pulses mainly in Lathyrus (86%), Urdbean (80%), Kulthi (74%), Moongbean (55%); 52.78% area of Shri Anna & Coarse Cereals mainly in Jowar (78.11%); 60.77% area of Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (63.54%); and 26.08% area of Rice has been harvested for Rabi crops 2024-25.
3. Rabi Season Area Coverage : For Rabi horticulture crops , major producing states report the following sowing areas: Onion - 10.93 lakh ha (9.72 lakh ha last year), Potato - 19.95 lakh ha (19.56 lakh ha last year), Tomato - 2.94 lakh ha (3.22 lakh ha last year).
4. Weather Update :
- a) Temperature: Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 3-5°C likely over many places over Northwest India during next 4 days and no significant change thereafter. Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 2-4°C likely over Central India and Interior Maharashtra during next 4-5 days. Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 2-3°C likely over Gujarat during next 3 days and
6. then fall by about 2-3°C thereafter.
- b) Rainfall Distribution: From Mar 01- 24 Mar, 2025, the All-India cumulative rainfall is 19% lower than its Long Period Average (LPA), with regional variations: (i) East & Northeast India: -15%; (ii) Northwest India: -32%; (iii) Central India: -30%; and South Peninsula: +45%. A fresh Western Disturbance likely to impact Western Himalayan region, from night of 24th march. Isolated to scattered light/moderate rainfall accompanied with thunderstorm, lightning likely over Jammu-Kashmir-Ladakh during 24th-27th; Himachal Pradesh during 25th-27th and over Uttarakhand on 26th & 27th March. Heavy rainfall/snowfall likely at isolated places over Jammu-Kashmir-Ladakh- on 26th March. Heavy rainfall likely at isolated places over Arunachal Pradesh on 28th March.

Overall, rainfall is likely to be above normal over south Peninsular India and below normal over rest parts of the country during the week.

## 5. Inputs Situation

- a) Water Reservoir Status : As of March 20th , 2025, the live storage in 155 major reservoirs is 80.70 BCM (45% of total capacity). Storage is at 118% of last year's level and 115% of the 10year average. The overall storage position is better than the corresponding period of last year in the country as a whole and is also better than the Normal storage during the corresponding period.

- c) Seeds and Fertilizers : For Rabi 2024-25, certified seed availability is 337.98 lakh quintals against a requirement of 307.07 lakh quintals, ensuring a surplus of 30.90 lakh quintals. The fertilizer supply remains stable across all products.
